description: Publish the Game Kit project so its play link opens without an account, and start its online server if the game is online (same API as the Publish button and `gripforge game-publish`). mode=preview shares a TEST build: no release checks (completion, animation proof), the project is marked preview; use it to let testers join an online game before it is release-ready. mode=release (default) runs the release checks and refuses with the blockers if the build is not ready. unpublish=true takes the game and its online server offline (mode is ignored). Needs an editor role on the owning workspace. Returns published, publicationMode and playUrl. 0 credits.

mode.description: preview: shared test build without release checks; release (default): full release checks.

project_id.description: Game Kit project id (gkp_…). Not a dedicated-server project (gpj_…) nor a Library item.

unpublish.description: true: take the game offline instead of publishing.

workspace_id.description: Workspace authorized by the current key. Never infer another user’s workspace.

name: gripforge_game_publish
title: Publish a game (preview or release) or take it offline
